view.note: board --view-yaw -40 --align idle is the griffin line's DEF view (README 'DEF view'). A creature facing right shows its RIGHT side: near = Right legs/arm/wing (GLB depth 2026-10-07: RightShoulder, RightUpLeg and WingR_00 are nearer; note the GLB's folded WingL_01..03 swing in front of WingR at idle) | 2026-10-07 lane-A wing-side fix: in spread frames the long wing reaching screen-left over the body is the NEAR (right) wing: at view yaw -40 the creature faces front-3/4, so its right side points screen-left and toward the camera (lateral and swept-back components add), while the far wing's cancel (short, upright, behind the head). Marks swapped near<->far in g20_move_start f1,2,3; g00_move f0,2,3; g21_move_end f0; g03_hitted f2,3,4; g04_defence f1,2,3,4,5,6; g12_attack_front f1,2,3; g05_death f1,2,3,4,5,6. Rig v5 bones mapped (QNeck/QJaw/QTal/QTail).
